marc:datafield.marc:subfield: In search of a college major and career direction

"Navigating your way through college and carer decisions is often both exciting and confusing. 'In Search of a College Major and Career Direction' is designed to guide students and parents through the important process of identifying personal preferences and exploring options. After watching this engaging DVD and completing the guides, you'll gain insight and answers to the most common and critical quetions in selecting and pursuing college major and career decisions."--Container back cover
